title: Funny Story
author: Emily Henry
summary: Daphne is left by her fiance for his best friend and ends up sharing a flat with the best friend's ex. The two new roommates agree to act like a couple online so everyone else keeps their distance.
readIf: you want a cosy, funny romance about starting over in a small lakeside town.
skipIf: you want something fresh; it follows familiar romance beats.

pairings.reason: Another story about two roommates who get to know each other in unusual circumstances.
Another Emily Henry story about a woman rebuilding in a small town.
A funnier-sadder book about a lonely woman gradually letting people in.
